description: This file implements classes and methods related to Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) convolution operations for Metal API, including data source management and convolution creation with specific parameters, primarily for iOS and macOS platforms.

classes.name: MPSCNNConvDataSource
classes.description: Data source class for MPSCNN convolution, managing weights, bias, and descriptor.

classes.name: MPSCNNConvOp
classes.description: Class representing a Metal Performance Shaders convolution operation, with a factory method for creating 2D convolution instances.

methods.name: initWithWeights:Bias:Desc:
methods.description: Initializes the data source with weights, bias, and convolution descriptor.

methods.name: copyWithZone:
methods.description: Creates a copy of the data source.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the data type used in the convolution (float32).

methods.name: load
methods.description: Indicates the data source is loaded successfully.

methods.name: conv2d
methods.description: Factory method to create a 2D convolution operation with specified parameters, weights, bias, and neuron filter.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the convolution operation into a Metal command buffer.
